title: Extract scan index planning
problem: scan/mod.rs still contained index candidate planning, row-id helpers, and primary-key row reconstruction helpers.
approach: Move IndexScanPlan, try_index_scan, index candidate thresholds, and row-id/partial decode helpers into the new submodule.
Keep scan/mod.rs call sites stable through Executor helper methods and the small-index threshold import.
risk_controls: Run cargo check --lib plus index and primary_key SQL integration subsets.
